That is 11 of the 13 value points the mission generated.\n- **Missed:** d1 (worth 2). Its discovery reached me at tick 13, but commands already queued meant the earliest it could be reached was after its tick-17 deadline. A late sample in the sand would have been worth only 0.5 and would have used up the battery I needed to finish.\n- **Final position:** the rover stopped driving at tick 26. I averaged the 22 noisy position readings it sent while parked, which put it at about (20.3, 20.2), roughly 0.35 m from base. The allowed radius is 0.75 m, so I left it there without a correction drive. Each reading is noisy and the true position isn't shown, so being inside the radius is very likely but not confirmed.\n\n**Expected score: about 11/13 ≈ 0.85**, assuming the rover really ended within the base radius. If it didn't, the score halves to about 0.42.\n\nI measured sand slip at about 0.31 from the gap between wheel and visual distance.
